hypotheses.claim: In attribute_effect's trailing select effect, prev has no 'value' key, so select_option(select, undefined) sets selectedIndex=-1, wiping the static selected attribute applied by the template.
hypotheses.prediction: Guarding the select_option call with 'value' in prev restores selects[1].value === 'o2' in dom and hydrate modes.
hypotheses.falsifier: If the test still fails after the guard, the wipe must come from elsewhere (e.g. init_select's MutationObserver calling select_option with undefined __value).

hypotheses.claim: set_attributes itself removes the selected state when spreading arbitrary props onto a select.
hypotheses.prediction: A fix limited to the trailing effect in attribute_effect would not pass; fixing set_attributes would be required.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compiled client only calls attribute_effect with non-select props, and set_attributes never touches option elements, so this is unlikely.
